title: Command & Conquer: Generals

engine.name: SAGE (Strategy Action Game Engine)
engine.evidence: Game.dat imports d3d8.dll, mss32.dll, binkw32.dll and the GameSpy SDK; W3D.big/Window.big content containers; WorldBuilder.exe ships with the game.
engine.notes: Generals.exe is a launcher (launcher.cfg/launcher.bmp), not the game. The renderer and simulation live in Game.dat, which is a PE DLL loaded by that launcher.

userState.evidence: publisher convention for SAGE titles; the folder does not exist on this machine yet because the title has never been launched here

dependencies.communityReplacement: Generals Online (playgenerals.online) after Revora retired Generals/Zero Hour from C&C:Online in 2026
dependencies.notes: The GameSpy service was shut down on 2014-06-30. Nothing in the campaign path requires it, but that has not been measured here.
Optional telemetry/advertising calls; a failure degrades nothing playable.

staticAnalysis.method: PE header/import parse plus ASCII and UTF-16 string scan of both binaries
staticAnalysis.limits: Generals.exe is .bind-wrapped by Steam, so its code is not readable statically; Game.dat is readable and carries the endpoint strings above. No runtime observation has been recorded yet.

notes: Native LAN mode is advertised in the game's own menus and would not need GameSpy, but that is a claim to measure, not a finding.
